Each item clearly states the relevant exam and subject section, provides four answer options, identifies the correct answer and offers a detailed solution.

The question distribution is influenced by the official exam patterns, such as the SSC CGL Tier‑1 exam which includes four sections of 25 questions each【968893519436774†L93-L116】, and other exams that emphasize reasoning, quantitative aptitude, general knowledge, English vocabulary and environment. This ensures comprehensive coverage across all levels of difficulty (easy, medium and hard) for upcoming examinations.

Q1. Exam/Subject: SSC/Railway Reasoning
Find the next term in the sequence: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
A. 8
B. 32
C. 34
D. 64
Answer: B
Solution: Each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by the common ratio 2. Thus, the next term after 16 is 16 × 2 = 32.

D. 384

B. 192
C. 194
D. 384
Answer: B

B. 192
C. 194
D. 384
Answer: B

B. 2560
C. 2564
D. 10240
Answer: B
Solution: Each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by the common ratio 4. Thus, the next term after 640 is 640 × 4 = 2560.

A. 48
B. 192
C. 194
D. 384
Answer: B
Solution: Each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by the common ratio 2. Thus, the next term after 96 is 96 × 2 = 192.

Q25001. Exam/Subject: Bank/RRB Quantitative Aptitude
What is the compound interest on Rs. 5000 at 4% per annum for 1 years (compounded annually)?
A. 220.0
B. 200.0
C. 180.0
D. 240.0
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 5000, r = 4% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 5200.00, so the compound interest is 200.0.

A. 2294.79
B. 2086.17
C. 1877.55
D. 2503.4
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 7948, r = 6% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 10034.17, so the compound interest is 2086.17.

A. 1229.9
B. 1118.09
C. 1006.28
D. 1341.71
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 9046, r = 6% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 10164.09, so the compound interest is 1118.09.

A. 946.94
B. 860.85
C. 774.76
D. 1033.02
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 9565, r = 9% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 10425.85, so the compound interest is 860.85.

A. 3861.48
B. 3510.44
C. 3159.4
D. 4212.53
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 9738, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 13248.44, so the compound interest is 3510.44.

A. 1579.71
B. 1436.1
C. 1292.49
D. 1723.32
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 9911, r = 7% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 11347.10, so the compound interest is 1436.1.

A. 3751.74
B. 3410.67
C. 3069.6
D. 4092.8
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 10084, r = 6% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 13494.67, so the compound interest is 3410.67.

A. 4800.4
B. 4364.0
C. 3927.6
D. 5236.8
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 10603, r = 9% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 14967.00, so the compound interest is 4364.0.

A. 3559.4
B. 3235.82
C. 2912.24
D. 3882.98
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 12328, r = 6% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 15563.82, so the compound interest is 3235.82.

A. 4253.95
B. 3867.23
C. 3480.51
D. 4640.68
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 12443, r = 7% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 16310.23, so the compound interest is 3867.23.

A. 4979.72
B. 4527.02
C. 4074.32
D. 5432.42
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 12558, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 17085.02, so the compound interest is 4527.02.

A. 5737.57
B. 5215.97
C. 4694.37
D. 6259.16
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 12673, r = 9% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 17888.97, so the compound interest is 5215.97.

A. 2389.37
B. 2172.15
C. 1954.94
D. 2606.58
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 12788, r = 4% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 14960.15, so the compound interest is 2172.15.

A. 3058.75
B. 2780.68
C. 2502.61
D. 3336.82
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 12903, r = 5% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 15683.68, so the compound interest is 2780.68.

A. 3758.62
B. 3416.93
C. 3075.24
D. 4100.32
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 13018, r = 6% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 16434.93, so the compound interest is 3416.93.

A. 4489.85
B. 4081.68
C. 3673.51
D. 4898.02
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 13133, r = 7% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 17214.68, so the compound interest is 4081.68.

A. 5253.34
B. 4775.76
C. 4298.18
D. 5730.91
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 13248, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 18023.76, so the compound interest is 4775.76.

A. 2518.29
B. 2289.35
C. 2060.41
D. 2747.22
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 13478, r = 4% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 15767.35, so the compound interest is 2289.35.

A. 3450.06
B. 3136.42
C. 2822.78
D. 3763.7
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 13937, r = 7% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 17073.42, so the compound interest is 3136.42.

A. 2954.89
B. 2686.26
C. 2417.63
D. 3223.51
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 14281, r = 9% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 16967.26, so the compound interest is 2686.26.

A. 4941.12
B. 4491.93
C. 4042.74
D. 5390.32
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 14453, r = 7% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 18944.93, so the compound interest is 4491.93.

A. 804.38
B. 731.25
C. 658.12
D. 877.5
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 14625, r = 5% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 15356.25, so the compound interest is 731.25.

A. 4802.09
B. 4365.54
C. 3928.99
D. 5238.65
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 14797, r = 9% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 19162.54, so the compound interest is 4365.54.

A. 6628.38
B. 6025.8
C. 5423.22
D. 7230.96
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 14969, r = 7% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 20994.80, so the compound interest is 6025.8.

A. 2882.64
B. 2620.58
C. 2358.52
D. 3144.7
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 15428, r = 4% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 18048.58, so the compound interest is 2620.58.

A. 3313.97
B. 3012.7
C. 2711.43
D. 3615.24
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 15772, r = 6% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 18784.70, so the compound interest is 3012.7.

C. 3108.88
D. 4145.17
Answer: B

A. 4880.49
B. 4436.81
C. 3993.13
D. 5324.17
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 16059, r = 5% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 20495.81, so the compound interest is 4436.81.

A. 3358.36
B. 3053.05
C. 2747.75
D. 3663.66
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 16231, r = 9% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 19284.05, so the compound interest is 3053.05.

A. 5607.79
B. 5097.99
C. 4588.19
D. 6117.59
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 16403, r = 7% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 21500.99, so the compound interest is 5097.99.

A. 5071.95
B. 4610.86
C. 4149.77
D. 5533.03
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 16689, r = 5% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 21299.86, so the compound interest is 4610.86.

A. 4884.65
B. 4440.59
C. 3996.53
D. 5328.71
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 16918, r = 6% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 21358.59, so the compound interest is 4440.59.

A. 751.96
B. 683.6
C. 615.24
D. 820.32
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 17090, r = 4% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 17773.60, so the compound interest is 683.6.

A. 5263.41
B. 4784.92
C. 4306.43
D. 5741.9
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 17319, r = 5% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 22103.92, so the compound interest is 4784.92.

A. 3619.07
B. 3290.06
C. 2961.05
D. 3948.07
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 17491, r = 9% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 20781.06, so the compound interest is 3290.06.

A. 6038.55
B. 5489.59
C. 4940.63
D. 6587.51
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 17663, r = 7% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 23152.59, so the compound interest is 5489.59.

A. 980.93
B. 891.75
C. 802.58
D. 1070.1
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 17835, r = 5% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 18726.75, so the compound interest is 891.75.

A. 6720.68
B. 6109.71
C. 5498.74
D. 7331.65
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 18064, r = 6% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 24173.71, so the compound interest is 6109.71.

A. 1636.87
B. 1488.06
C. 1339.25
D. 1785.67
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 18236, r = 4% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 19724.06, so the compound interest is 1488.06.

A. 7299.47
B. 6635.88
C. 5972.29
D. 7963.06
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 18408, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 25043.88, so the compound interest is 6635.88.

A. 1226.28
B. 1114.8
C. 1003.32
D. 1337.76
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 18580, r = 6% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 19694.80, so the compound interest is 1114.8.

A. 2575.59
B. 2341.45
C. 2107.3
D. 2809.74
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 18752, r = 4% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 21093.45, so the compound interest is 2341.45.

A. 1050.23
B. 954.75
C. 859.27
D. 1145.7
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 19095, r = 5% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 20049.75, so the compound interest is 954.75.

A. 6252.75
B. 5684.32
C. 5115.89
D. 6821.18
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 19267, r = 9% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 24951.32, so the compound interest is 5684.32.

A. 8607.72
B. 7825.2
C. 7042.68
D. 9390.24
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 19439, r = 7% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 27264.20, so the compound interest is 7825.2.

A. 2211.14
B. 2010.13
C. 1809.12
D. 2412.16
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 19611, r = 5% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 21621.13, so the compound interest is 2010.13.

A. 8956.55
B. 8142.32
C. 7328.09
D. 9770.78
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 19783, r = 9% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 27925.32, so the compound interest is 8142.32.

A. 2748.66
B. 2498.78
C. 2248.9
D. 2998.54
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 20012, r = 4% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 22510.78, so the compound interest is 2498.78.

A. 8048.92
B. 7317.2
C. 6585.48
D. 8780.64
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 20298, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 27615.20, so the compound interest is 7317.2.

A. 1351.02
B. 1228.2
C. 1105.38
D. 1473.84
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 20470, r = 6% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 21698.20, so the compound interest is 1228.2.

A. 1863.06
B. 1693.69
C. 1524.32
D. 2032.43
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 20756, r = 4% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 22449.69, so the compound interest is 1693.69.

A. 1154.18
B. 1049.25
C. 944.33
D. 1259.1
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 20985, r = 5% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 22034.25, so the compound interest is 1049.25.

A. 6866.12
B. 6241.93
C. 5617.74
D. 7490.32
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 21157, r = 9% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 27398.93, so the compound interest is 6241.93.

A. 1919.61
B. 1745.1
C. 1570.59
D. 2094.12
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 21386, r = 4% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 23131.10, so the compound interest is 1745.1.

A. 8548.56
B. 7771.42
C. 6994.28
D. 9325.7
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 21558, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 29329.42, so the compound interest is 7771.42.

A. 1434.18
B. 1303.8
C. 1173.42
D. 1564.56
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 21730, r = 6% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 23033.80, so the compound interest is 1303.8.

A. 3008.25
B. 2734.77
C. 2461.29
D. 3281.72
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 21902, r = 4% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 24636.77, so the compound interest is 2734.77.

A. 8798.38
B. 7998.53
C. 7198.68
D. 9598.24
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 22188, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 30186.53, so the compound interest is 7998.53.

A. 7275.04
B. 6613.67
C. 5952.3
D. 7936.4
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 22417, r = 9% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 29030.67, so the compound interest is 6613.67.

A. 5648.29
B. 5134.81
C. 4621.33
D. 6161.77
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 22817, r = 7% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 27951.81, so the compound interest is 5134.81.

A. 5476.72
B. 4978.84
C. 4480.96
D. 5974.61
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 23103, r = 5% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 28081.84, so the compound interest is 4978.84.

A. 4902.47
B. 4456.79
C. 4011.11
D. 5348.15
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 23332, r = 6% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 27788.79, so the compound interest is 4456.79.

A. 5601.43
B. 5092.21
C. 4582.99
D. 6110.65
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 23504, r = 4% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 28596.21, so the compound interest is 5092.21.

A. 4333.66
B. 3939.69
C. 3545.72
D. 4727.63
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 23676, r = 8% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 27615.69, so the compound interest is 3939.69.

A. 6885.51
B. 6259.55
C. 5633.6
D. 7511.46
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 23848, r = 6% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 30107.55, so the compound interest is 6259.55.

A. 1056.88
B. 960.8
C. 864.72
D. 1152.96
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 24020, r = 4% and t = 1 years. The amount after 1 years is 24980.80, so the compound interest is 960.8.

A. 6911.25
B. 6282.95
C. 5654.65
D. 7539.54
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 24192, r = 8% and t = 3 years. The amount after 3 years is 30474.95, so the compound interest is 6282.95.

A. 9064.58
B. 8240.53
C. 7416.48
D. 9888.64
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 24364, r = 6% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 32604.53, so the compound interest is 8240.53.

A. 2202.35
B. 2002.14
C. 1801.93
D. 2402.57
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 24536, r = 4% and t = 2 years. The amount after 2 years is 26538.14, so the compound interest is 2002.14.

A. 9797.66
B. 8906.96
C. 8016.26
D. 10688.35
Answer: B
Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 24708, r = 8% and t = 4 years. The amount after 4 years is 33614.96, so the compound interest is 8906.96.

B. 7357.14
C. 6621.43
D. 8828.57
Answer: B

Solution: Compound interest is calculated using the formula A = P(1 + r/100)^t. Here P = 24994, r = 6% and t = 5 years. The amount after 5 years is 33447.61, so the compound interest is 8453.61.

C. brief
D. hardworking
Answer: B
Solution: 'ubiquitous' means 'omnipresent'. The other options are not synonyms of 'ubiquitous'.
